site.name: NiveshMarg
site.subtitle: निवेश · मार्ग
site.description: AI stock research, portfolio analysis and disciplined investment workflows for modern investors.

home.headline: Unlock Your Investing Edge
home.description: Six specialist AI analysts research a stock, argue the bull case against the bear case, and hand you a verdict with entry, target and stop levels attached — for NSE listings and global markets alike.

features.title: AI Score
features.summary: NiveshMarg converts four independent market lenses into one clear signal so you can see both the trend and the evidence behind it.

highlights.title: Evidence before verdict
highlights.detail: A score looks reliable only when each pillar is visible. The workspace shows which readings are reinforcing one another and which ones are weakening the case.

highlights.title: Balanced by design
highlights.detail: The model weighs the signal using four lenses instead of a single narrative, which reduces the risk of a strong story masking weak execution.

highlights.title: Decision-ready output
highlights.detail: Whether you are screening a fast mover or validating a home-position thesis, the score becomes a shorthand for deeper due diligence.

process: Collect short-term price momentum and trend structure.
Assess sentiment, news tone and market reaction.
Compare the result against fundamentals and valuation signals.
Present a single confidence score with all four readings visible.
impact: Helps compare ideas without losing the underlying rationale.
Shortens the time between discovery and decision-making.
Makes portfolio reviews easier to defend with numbers.

features.title: The Swarm
features.summary: Six specialist AI analysts challenge one another, then converge into one actionable verdict with a clear bull case, bear case, and risk levels.

highlights.title: Every thesis is argued
highlights.detail: Instead of one polished answer, the system produces a structured debate: what the bull case sees, what the bear case fears, and where the gap actually sits.

highlights.title: Risk is not hidden
highlights.detail: The risk manager calls out downside, breaks the setup and highlights when conviction should weaken. That discipline protects against overconfidence.

highlights.title: Verdict with numbers
highlights.detail: Entry, target and stop levels stay attached to the reasoning so users can evaluate whether the risk-reward matches the idea.

process: Every analyst investigates a different dimension: valuation, momentum, news, macro, quality and risk.
Findings are compared and contested before a shared conclusion is drafted.
The final view includes risk levels and a concrete action range.
Users can revisit the argument instead of relying on a summary alone.
impact: Reduces one-sided thinking in investment research.
Builds confidence through transparent disagreement.
Turns analysis into a reviewable decision trail.

features.title: Workspace
features.summary: The workspace is where research, positions, strategy testing, and reporting live together, so the investor does not need to jump between tools.

highlights.title: A single operating surface
highlights.detail: Dashboard, watchlist, portfolio diagnostics, screening, and paper trading remain connected, reducing friction between thought and action.

highlights.title: Research with discipline
highlights.detail: The portfolio doctor highlights concentration, drift, and risk, while backtesting and strategy rules help validate ideas before capital is committed.

highlights.title: Decision records that travel
highlights.detail: Reports and exports package the reasoning and the data in a simple format for follow-up, review or board-level communication.

process: Bring in a portfolio, watchlist or one ticker you want to study.
Review live holdings, signals and diagnostic views in one screen.
Test ideas with paper trading, strategies and historical review.
Share or export the final record when the decision is ready.
impact: Cuts the admin overhead of active investing.
Makes portfolio decisions easier to review and defend.
Keeps strategy and execution in the same system.

features.title: Portfolio Doctor
features.summary: The Portfolio Doctor reviews your portfolio like a disciplined analyst, surfacing concentration, drift, imbalance and resilience before emotions or market noise take over.

highlights.title: Diagnose concentration early
highlights.detail: The doctor highlights when too much of the portfolio lives in one theme, sector or stock so overconfidence is corrected before it becomes a problem.

highlights.title: Spot drift before it hurts
highlights.detail: As positions move away from the strategic mix, the system flags where the portfolio is no longer aligned with the intended risk profile.

highlights.title: Give actionable direction
highlights.detail: Rather than leaving you with a warning, it suggests whether to rebalance, trim, rotate or hold based on the shape of the portfolio.

process: Map your current holdings and allocation across sectors, themes and risk buckets.
Measure concentration, drift and diversification against your intended balance.
Highlight the largest sources of exposure and the signals that may be distorting the portfolio.
Recommend the next move: rebalance, reduce concentration, or keep holding with a clearer plan.
impact: Helps investors avoid silent portfolio drift.
Turns portfolio reviews into proactive risk management.
Gives every holding a clearer place inside the wider plan.

features.title: Paper Trading
features.summary: Paper trading gives investors a safe environment to test strategy, hone execution and learn from market behavior without placing real capital on the line.

highlights.title: Build discipline without real risk
highlights.detail: You can experiment with entries, exits and position sizing in a realistic market environment without exposing actual capital to the noise of emotion.

highlights.title: Test ideas against real market motion
highlights.detail: Paper trading lets you replay monthly and weekly behaviour, evaluate setups and compare whether a thesis holds up under forward-moving conditions.

highlights.title: Turn mistakes into feedback
highlights.detail: Every trade, win or miss, helps sharpen your decision structure and uncover where your strategy is reliable and where it needs adjustment.

process: Select a stock, strategy or setup you want to practice.
Place virtual trades using live price and position logic.
Review execution quality, risk control and result quality in context.
Refine the plan before moving from rehearsal to real capital.
impact: Reduces the cost of learning when market timing is tough.
Improves execution quality by removing emotional friction.
Builds confidence with a repeatable, evidence-based process.

media.title: Live paper trading board
media.caption: A market dashboard where strategy, entry levels and risk can be reviewed before real money is involved.

media.title: Simulation walkthrough
media.caption: See how a paper trade can be monitored, evaluated and refined in realistic market conditions.

features.title: Backtesting & Strategy Builder
features.summary: This feature combines historical validation with visual strategy design so investors can test ideas, refine rules, and see whether a system has edge before it reaches live capital.

highlights.title: Design strategy without coding friction
highlights.detail: The strategy builder lets you define conditions and rules visually, turning investment logic into a repeatable framework instead of a collection of ad hoc impulses.

highlights.title: Test against real market history
highlights.detail: Backtesting evaluates a strategy across historical market conditions so you can see if the framework survives noise, volatility, sector rotations and weak trends.

highlights.title: Use evidence before increasing conviction
highlights.detail: You can compare outcomes, understand drawdowns, and decide whether a setup deserves a forward test or more refinement before it becomes a live decision.

process: Map the market conditions, entry rules and risk controls you want to test.
Build the strategy with a visual logic layer that is easy to review and adjust.
Run it across historical data to measure performance, volatility and drawdown.
Refine the rules and repeat until the strategy is consistent, understandable and defensible.
impact: Improves conviction by replacing guesswork with historical evidence.
Helps reduce overfitting by measuring performance across different phases.
Turns trading logic into a repeatable system that can be reviewed with clarity.

media.title: Strategy canvas
media.caption: A visual strategy workspace showing how rules, timing and allocation can be structured before execution.

media.title: Backtest walkthrough
media.caption: A walkthrough of a historical strategy test that reveals performance, risk exposure and trade quality.

features.title: Watchlist
features.summary: The Watchlist keeps the names that matter most in a single, easy-to-scan workspace so investors can monitor opportunities, track conviction and capture changes without losing context.

highlights.title: Keep the right names in view
highlights.detail: Track your current opportunities, watchlists and ideas in one place without losing the context that made them worth revisiting.

highlights.title: Prioritize with intent
highlights.detail: Rank positions by conviction, urgency and research stage so your attention follows the ideas with the highest chance of pay-off.

highlights.title: Monitor changes without noise
highlights.detail: Watch price moves, signal updates, and note changes over time so you can respond to real shifts instead of reacting to every headline.

process: Add the names you want to follow and assign them to the right priority bucket.
Track price action, AI score changes and research context alongside your notes.
Monitor catalysts, thresholds and momentum shifts without searching across multiple tools.
Use the list to decide when to act, revisit, or remove a name from focus.
impact: Improves focus by limiting attention to a curated set of names.
Makes opportunity tracking more consistent across busy market days.
Helps investors use context rather than impulse when they decide to act.

media.title: Priority watchlist grid
media.caption: A clean tracking board that helps investors monitor priority names, easy reads and shifts in conviction.

media.title: Watchlist alert flow
media.caption: A simple walkthrough of how alerts and updates can surface the meaningful changes in a watchlist.

features.title: Stock Chat
features.summary: Stock Chat turns natural-language questions into market insight, helping investors ask for context, comparison and reasoning without wading through tabs or raw data dumps.

highlights.title: Ask in plain English
highlights.detail: Instead of forcing users into technical queries, the chat layer understands natural questions like what is driving momentum, how this compares with peers, or what risks matter most.

highlights.title: Ground the answer in your context
highlights.detail: It can work from live prices, indicators, fundamentals, news and portfolio context so answers stay actionable instead of generic commentary.

highlights.title: Use it as a research companion
highlights.detail: The conversation becomes a guided way to challenge assumptions, compare themes and narrow down where deeper review is worth your time.

process: Ask a question in your own words about a stock, sector or portfolio theme.
Pull in live market, fundamentals and portfolio context for the answer.
Summarise the likely drivers, risks and next checks in plain language.
Use the response to decide where to dive deeper or to keep the thesis in view.
impact: Makes market research more conversational and less manual.
Helps investors understand the 'why' behind a move faster.
Transforms raw data into a faster decision-making loop.

features.title: Institutional Flow
features.summary: Institutional Flow brings attention to the forces that move the market beyond headline noise, surfacing where smart money is leaning and how that interacts with your own portfolio decisions.

highlights.title: Track where interest is building
highlights.detail: The feature helps you understand whether risk is rotating into a theme, sector or idea so you can better interpret broader market behaviour.

highlights.title: Separate signal from hype
highlights.detail: By pairing flow signals with your own portfolio context, it becomes easier to tell whether attention is becoming conviction or just another short-lived headline.

highlights.title: Support calmer decisions
highlights.detail: Institutional flow adds a wider lens to your process, reducing the chance that you react to isolated moves without understanding the bigger structure.

process: Review the trend in participation, focus and leadership across sectors or stocks.
Compare current flow with the broader market backdrop and your own exposure.
Look for shifts in conviction, risk appetite and concentration before acting.
Use the context to refine timing, sizing and risk management.
impact: Helps investors read the market with more context.
Adds a macro lens without overwhelming day-to-day decisions.
Improves risk-awareness when momentum changes quickly.

features.title: Reports & Exports
features.summary: Reports & Exports turns research and portfolio decisions into clean, board-ready summaries so you can review a thesis, share a result, or document the logic behind an action.

highlights.title: Package the decision, not just the data
highlights.detail: The export captures the reasoning, trade logic and key risk points so a decision can be reviewed later without needing to reconstruct the whole story.

highlights.title: Helpful for team or family review
highlights.detail: Whether you are reviewing a thesis with a partner or preparing a summary for a stakeholder, the output keeps the answer concise and readable.

highlights.title: Build better habits around review
highlights.detail: Good records make it easier to learn from the process, understand mistakes and improve portfolio decisions over time.

process: Collect the portfolio, chart or strategy context you want to summarise.
Turn the research notes into a structured recommendation or review document.
Export the record in a clean format for future reference or sharing.
Use the report to revisit the idea, compare outcomes and learn from your process.
impact: Improves accountability in research and investing decisions.
Makes it easier to communicate a thesis clearly and confidently.
Creates a durable record for learning and follow-through.

features.title: How it Works
features.summary: The experience is designed around a disciplined investment path: gather positions, run the debate, test the idea, then keep a record of the decision.

highlights.title: Start with what you own
highlights.detail: The workflow is anchored around your actual holdings and the names you are watching, not a disconnected market dashboard.

highlights.title: Let the process do the heavy lifting
highlights.detail: From research swarm to risk checks and strategy testing, the product keeps a consistent thread between idea generation and action.

highlights.title: Keep the record, not just the result
highlights.detail: Reports remain auditable long after the decision was made, making learning and review more straightforward.

process: Bring your holdings and target names into the workspace.
Run the swarm and review the evidence behind each conclusion.
Backtest or paper trade the logic before the money is committed.
Export the verdict and continue the journey with a clear record.
impact: Makes decision-making feel deliberate rather than reactive.
Builds a habit of reviewing the logic behind outcomes.
Turns investing into a repeatable, teachable system.
